title: Pastoral Dance

outfit_card.silhouette: A layered pastoral ensemble featuring a cropped dark bolero jacket over a corseted bodice, paired with a voluminous bell-shaped skirt and an asymmetrical sheer lace apron overlay.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: Large curled ram horns, braided hair ribbons, and a cluster of crystalline floral buds adorning the side of the head.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: Fitted dark bodice with intricate silver embroidery and front button placket, topped by a sheer white lace capelet; sleeves are full puffed bishop styles ending in ruffled lace cuffs with delicate ribbon ties.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: Tiered dark underskirt with a pleated hem, overlaid by a prominent white lace apron featuring scalloped edges and a large central floral medallion, completed with sheer stockings and dark heeled boots.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: A small silver handbell with a tassel, floating luminous butterflies, and scattered floral buds accenting the pastoral theme.
